limitation: Full deep-RL MARL stacks (PRIMAL/SCRIMP) require GPU training over millions of steps which is infeasible in this short, CPU-only session. We therefore implement an MARL-style decentralized cooperative tabular Q-learning agent with PRIMAL-style local FOV observation and reward shaping, and use it as the LNS repair operator. This is documented in the report.
